title: Xdrip with libre raw value in addition
symptom: User is using xDrip+ with a Libre sensor and scanning via NFC. They miss the sensor raw values in the graph and in brackets behind the measured bg-value after scanning.
fix: xDrip shows the raw values in the bg data table. Go to settings->less common settings->enable databases to enable this option. However, Libre sensor only stores data for the latest 15 minutes, so you need to use the BluCon to get the values constantly.
